title: Top High Converting Facebook Ad Examples for Contractors

facts.fact: PipelineOn's blog cites PPC Land's cross-vertical analysis as putting the average Facebook lead campaign cost per lead at $27.66 in 2025, a 21% year-over-year increase.
facts.quote: The average Facebook lead campaign CPL hit $27.66 in 2025, a 21% year-over-year jump

facts.fact: PipelineOn's blog cites LeadsBridge's 2025 case data as showing lead form ads convert 25-35% higher than landing page ads for home service contractors.
facts.quote: Lead form ads convert 25-35% higher than landing page ads** for home service contractors, per LeadsBridge's 2025 case data.

facts.fact: According to Mammoth for Plumbers' 2025 case study, a Dallas plumber generated $76,608 in revenue from $1,500 in Facebook spend, a 51x ROAS.
facts.quote: A Dallas plumber running this exact structure generated $76,608 from $1,500 in Facebook spend** - 112 inbound calls at a $684 average ticket, 51x ROAS, per Mammoth for Plumbers' 2025 case study.

facts.fact: The Mammoth for Plumbers case study reports the Dallas plumber received 112 inbound calls at a $684 average ticket.
facts.quote: 112 inbound calls at a $684 average ticket, 51x ROAS, per Mammoth for Plumbers' 2025 case study.

facts.fact: PipelineOn's blog reports that top-quartile HVAC advertisers reached 5.17x ROAS on Facebook versus a 1.65x spend-weighted median; the page does not name a source for these figures.
facts.quote: Top-quartile HVAC advertisers hit 5.17x ROAS on Facebook vs the 1.65x spend-weighted median

facts.fact: The blog cites WordStream's 2025 benchmark report for the claim that users have about three seconds to stop the scroll before the algorithm deprioritizes an ad.
facts.quote: You have three seconds to stop the scroll before the algorithm deprioritizes the ad, per WordStream's 2025 benchmark report.

facts.fact: PipelineOn's blog states that ads still convert at $35-$55 per booked HVAC or plumbing lead.
facts.quote: The ads that still convert at $35-$55 per booked HVAC or plumbing lead share a pattern.

facts.fact: In the page's sample HVAC ad, the pre-season tune-up offer is priced at $89 and includes a 22-point inspection.
facts.quote: $89 22-point pre-season tune-up. We check refrigerant, electrical, drain line, and capacitor.

facts.fact: In the page's sample water heater ad, financing is offered at $89/month on a new 50-gallon Bradford White install with a 10-year tank warranty.
facts.quote: $89/month financing on a new 50-gallon Bradford White install. Same-day install in most cases. 10-year tank warranty.

facts.fact: According to Service Finance Company's 2025 survey, 78% of homeowners say payment options influence their contractor choice.
facts.quote: 78% of homeowners say payment options influence their contractor choice**, per Service Finance Company's 2025 survey.

facts.fact: The sample water heater ad states the average residential water heater lasts 8-12 years, with no source given.
facts.quote: The average residential water heater lasts 8-12 years.

facts.fact: The sample lawn care ad offers weekly mowing at $35/week for lots under 5,000 sqft and says rates are held through October if the customer signs by April 30.
facts.quote: $35/week for lots under 5,000 sqft. Includes mow, edge, blow, and trimmer work along fences.

facts.fact: The sample lawn care ad says the business caps routes at 30 homes.
facts.quote: Tap to lock your slot - we cap routes at 30 homes.

facts.fact: The page reports an anonymous roofing operator on r/sweatystartup generated 412 inspection requests in 11 days at a $4.20 cost per lead, versus a normal CPL of $38.
facts.quote: generated **412 inspection requests in 11 days at a $4.20 cost per lead** - normal CPL was $38.

facts.fact: The sample HVAC ad says Phoenix tune-ups totaled over 2,400 in 2025, with a 4.9-star Google rating; these are example ad claims, not verified figures.
facts.quote: Over 2,400 Phoenix-area tune-ups in 2025. 4.9 stars on Google.
